blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, ILOCOS SUR, Philippines — Members of the Kalesa Association of Laoag City in nearby Ilocos Norte are undergoing skills training and upgrading of their traditional horse-drawn carriages or “kalesa” as part of an initiative to revive a cultural icon and mode of transportation in the city, the Laoag City Tourism Office said Monday,
